_about: The studio queue. "apps" come first (the owner's decision, 2026-11-11), in the owner's order, one at a time; then "games". Order = build priority. status: queued | building | first-playable | polishing | ready-to-play | shipped | parked (apps: queued | building | ready-to-test | shipped | parked). The site page and the loop both read this file.

apps.title: Plainproof
apps.tagline: Photos, serial numbers and values of what you own, room by room, with a PDF report for an insurance claim.
apps.note: Named Plainproof by the owner on 2026-11-11 (was Roomfile, slug home-inventory). Build 1.0.0 (26) is uploaded to TestFlight: the welcome picture, a drawer that shows every room's folder with an opening that slides with the finger, and cabinets for more than one place, all from the owner's first evening with it on his iPhone. Two critics: almost. Owned by the owner's Plainproof conversation until it ships (STUDIO.md, block log).

apps.title: Warranty and receipt vault
apps.tagline: Snap a receipt, keep the purchase date and warranty length, and hear about it before the warranty runs out.

apps.title: Home and car maintenance log
apps.tagline: Furnace filters, smoke detector batteries, oil changes and the like, each with a repeating reminder.

apps.title: Photo metadata stripper
apps.tagline: Takes the GPS location and camera details out of a photo before you share it, straight from the share sheet.

apps.title: Trip and roommate expense splitter
apps.tagline: One person logs the expenses; the app works out who owes whom in the fewest payments and shares a summary.

apps.title: Pet care log
apps.tagline: Vet visits, medicine, weight and feeding for every pet in the house.

apps.title: Gift tracker
apps.tagline: Gift ideas and budgets for each person, with a reminder before every birthday.

apps.title: Collection catalog
apps.tagline: Cards, coins, vinyl or LEGO: photos, condition and what you paid.

apps.title: Chore chart
apps.tagline: Kids earn points or allowance for chores and a parent approves. A parent's app: no ads, nothing collected.

apps.title: Plainlimit
apps.tagline: A six-cell battery on the home screen that drains as the day's screen time is used, then recharges at a time you set.
apps.note: Outside the list of nine: added by the owner on 2026-11-11 and built in the owner's own conversation. The daily backstop leaves it alone. The preview runs on pretend use; the real screen-time parts wait for Apple's Family Controls approval and a development build (apps/plainlimit/NOTES.md)

_apps_order_reason: 2026-11-11: the owner's order. Work them top-down, one app at a time, each to 'ready to test' (the bar in STUDIO.md, 'Apps'), ahead of all game work. Titles are working titles until each store name is chosen.

games.title: Burn Down a Forest
games.tagline: A cursed forest swallowed the valley overnight. Burn it back with a match, then a torch, then a dragon.
games.note: Ship prep done (Godot 4.7.2, real ads and purchases with placeholder ids). Needs the owner's ids and store assets

games.title: Dig to the Core
games.tagline: Shovel, drill, laser. Dig straight down through fossils and a T. rex to the middle of the Earth.
games.note: Critic: almost. Polish pass 1 done (review 3, all 11 items + phone readability; smoke 92, boosted, keen 23:59, browser). Next: ship prep (Godot 4.7.2 + real ads and purchases), then a fourth critic.

games.title: Burn a Cardboard City
games.tagline: Someone built a whole city out of cardboard. It would be a shame if it caught fire.
games.note: Ship prep done (Godot 4.7.2, real ads and purchases with placeholder ids). Needs the owner's ids, store assets and its last polish pass

games.title: Drain an Ocean
games.tagline: Pump the sea dry and watch shipwrecks, sunken treasure and finally Atlantis come up for air.
games.note: Critic: no. Fixes + full QA in progress

games.title: Eat a Giant Cake
games.tagline: You are tiny and the cake is enormous. Spoon, fork, stand mixer, through frosting, sponge and jam.
games.note: Paused before any files were written: no new game until the first is in App Review (North star)

games.title: Dust a Haunted House
games.tagline: A century of dust and cobwebs, and something is hiding under every layer.
games.note: Next new game when a slot opens after the first launch: cleaning is a proven satisfying theme and nothing in the catalog is like it (research/market.md)

games.title: Unbury a Pyramid
games.tagline: Blow away a desert of sand to uncover a buried pyramid, with mummies who help if you ask nicely.

games.title: Erase a Mountain
games.tagline: Chisel, dynamite, laser. Take a whole mountain apart and find the temple sealed inside.

games.title: Thaw a Frozen Planet
games.tagline: A whole tiny planet frozen solid. Walk all the way around it and bring summer back.
games.note: A melting game like the reference game: adds the least and carries similar-app review risk; could be a map in an existing game

games.title: Defrost a Freezer
games.tagline: You are tiny, the freezer is ancient, and somewhere under the ice is a pizza from 1987.
games.note: Closest to Melt a Glacier; may ship as a Melt a Glacier map instead of its own app

_order_reason: 2026-11-09: ordered by expected money per month per hour of work and how soon each can ship (research/market.md). Games in progress come first, closest to ready first; no new game starts until the first one is in App Review.
